text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haa... pheww...!
...Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Just 30 more houses left to post!
If I can deliver them before the sun comes up—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's a new record, yup!

—The Twinkle Series.
The dream stage for every Umamusume.

A goosebump-inducing, fierce battle. Heat seeping deep into the bone.
Runners lunging headlong for the goal.

Seeking proud honor, seeking childhood dreams.
The Umamusume reach for the throne.

And here is another Umamusume
about to plunge into that very world.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (...This is a wish for good luck. For the future that awaits me...!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew..., haah...!
If I can visit all 30 places
within the next 30 minutes—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I can finally make my Twinkle Series
debut as an Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Store Manager~!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Part-timer No. 7, Ines!
Has just arrived!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Mornin', Ines...
You're full of energy so early in the day.
Take out the trash while you're at it, please~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ugh. Boss, you're working me way too hard~! You'd better raise my hourly wage next month to make up for this!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
"That's a no-go. Besides, is it really okay to schedule shifts
for next month too? Didn't that thing get decided already?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...! Yeah, that's right, Boss!
I'm finally—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to make my debut
in the Twinkle Series!!

Starting today, training towards the Twinkle Series
with Ines Fujin begins!

I review the menu I put together last night.
It looks like all the prepared equipment is ready as well.
Glancing at the watch on my wrist—
choice_data_list: ...Only 10 minutes left until morning practice starts, huh?

text_block_list.text:
Actually, on the day her debut was decided,
she had made a certain request of me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Even after I debut,
I want to keep working my part-time job!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Of course I won't cause any trouble!
I definitely, absolutely won't be late because of my part-time job!
She's an extremely earnest Umamusume. You don't need to worry about her being late. However—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa, Oguri-san!
You looked so cool in last year's race too~!
Umamusume who had already finished warming up were gathering on the track one after another.

And bathing in the loudest cheers of all
is the star Umamusume, Oguri Cap.

She is the driving force leading
the current racing boom. The one expected
to carry that torch next is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Ryan.
That burst of yours in the final 400 meters was brilliant.
I truly thought you had me on that lap.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Look who's talking, McQueen! That tough running style that never lets anyone pass—your strength is incredible as always!

Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan.
Both promising stars of the renowned Mejiro family, and classmates of Ines Fujin.

If two girls who've been turning heads since before their debut were to become future rivals...
Frankly, we couldn't afford to waste a single second of practice.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hallo hallo, Trainer!
Right on time! Let's get morning training started!
choice_data_list: Yeah, shall we get started right away?
Yeah, let's get started right away!

text_block_list.text:
"Today's routine consists of strength training and two hill runs.
For a pre-debut Umamusume,
it's a relatively heavy workload."

"However, not only will she be competing against
two members of the Mejiro family from now on,
but she's also a transfer student who joined in high school."
"To be honest, she lacks everything: the muscle required for racing, the racing instincts... all of it. That is precisely why..."
choice_data_list: I'm gonna whip you into shape!
I'm gonna whip you into shape, okay!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aha, okaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!
And so, Ines Fujin completed the entire prepared menu—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *gasp*, *pant*~...
*phew*... *sigh*~...
choice_data_list: You really gave it everything you had...!
You really gave it everything you had...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha. I mean, if I'm gonna run anyway...
I'd rather face it with my engine at full throttle... you know?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The racing world I'd watched ever since I was little
was right here within my reach, and—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing could make me happier than I am right now!
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, phone call!
Whoops... excuse me!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hello?
Ah, Su-chan and Lu-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...You got the present? Awesome!
How do the new shoes feel?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha. That's because you two worked so hard!
Big Sis is cheering you on a whole bunch too.
...Mm-hmm, yeah. ...Go for it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it was from Su-chan and the others.
Honestly... there was no need to call just to say thanks.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, haven't you met them before?
My little sisters, Su-chan and Lu-chan.
They're twins!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Both of them take dance lessons, and they're so good
the teacher always praises them.
Their sync is spot-on, and their sense is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So the other day, I used money from my
part-time job to buy her a pair of shoes as a gift.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Her old shoes were so heavily worn
that they were practically falling apart."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm someone who was indulged
when I selfishly said, 'I want to run,' too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If my little sister has a dream too, I want to support her with all my heart!
choice_data_list: So that's why you want to keep your part-time job.
So that's why you want to keep your part-time job.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list: ...Even if you suffer a time disadvantage?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I know I'm being naive.
Trying to race while working a part-time job...
Even though I need more practice than the other girls.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I know.
I know that, but still—
choice_data_list: Got it, then let's tackle this together!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha, that was unexpected.
Were you really okay replying so quickly?
choice_data_list: If it's precious to you, I want to treasure it too.
If it's precious to you, I want to cherish it too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, really?
You'll treasure anything I give you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No taking those words back, okay?♪
Fufu, which one should I say is
precious to me next, I wonder~?

"...Even though I've promised her that,
in reality, there's still a lot to consider."

How should I help her grow?
To make the most of our limited time, I should rework her future training menu—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Trainer!
Let's have a great training session today too—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's wrong!?
You have massive dark circles under your eyes!?
choice_data_list: I was just getting ready for training...

text_block_list.text: Ever since then, I spent all night putting together a list of training routines I wanted her to try, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's see? Stretching, jogging, ladder drills, and perimeter laps.
Plus weight training, stair dashes, and gate practice. Also using mini hurdles...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "...Even with all my stamina, asking me to do all this in a single day is just impossible."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Pfft... Ahaha.
When I got your reply yesterday,
I thought you seemed so dependable, too."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, but I will give you full credit
for spending a whole looot of time on me!
Full marks!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now then, which training shall we start with?
Even if we can't do it all, we can tackle as much as we can!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Besides, if it's something you teach me, Trainer, I know it can never go wrong!"

And so, our training days began,
with Ines Fujin providing full support along the way!
